**Limitations**

- Pixels with the wrong curvature come out white, the same as the strongest lines, because scikit-image sets responses of exactly 0 to 1. Read the result together with the Frangi filter.
- Gamma is in pixel levels, so the response depends on the contrast of the image.
- As with Frangi, wide lines respond far more weakly than thin ones when small scales are included.
- On noisy images, many pixels of the background have the wrong curvature, so the result is full of white speckles.

**Artifacts**

- White patches on the wrong side of edges, such as the inside of bright shapes when looking for dark ridges.
- White speckles over noisy flat areas.
